items.title: @HowToPrompt__：Chinese researchers did it again! Kimi published an attention architecture that runs LLMs 6x faster and uses 75% less GP
items.abstract_or_text: Chinese researchers did it again! Kimi published an attention architecture that runs LLMs 6x faster and uses 75% less GPU memory than full attention. Moonshot AI just published a paper introducing Kimi Linear. It is a hybrid linear attention architecture that doesn't just match standard full attention. For the first time in AI history, it beats it. Across every single benchmark. At its core is Kimi Delta Attention (KDA). They pre-trained a massive model with 48 billion total parameters (3 billion activated) using a mix of KDA and Multi-Head Latent Attention. • 6× faster decoding throughput on a 1-million-token context. • 75% reduction in KV cache usage. • Outperforming traditional full-attention models across short-context, long-context, and RL scaling tasks.

items.title: @AnimaAnandkumar：Tackling a 60-year-old challenge in quantum chemistry: making density functional theory scale nearly linearly with syste
items.abstract_or_text: Tackling a 60-year-old challenge in quantum chemistry: making density functional theory scale nearly linearly with system size. This has huge implications for opening the door to realistic systems that have traditionally been too expensive to simulate. AI has attempted to accelerate these calculations, but models generally struggle to extrapolate, particularly to systems larger than those seen during training. Unlike text or images, quantum-mechanical training data is extremely expensive to generate. We present a single unified AI model that performs quantum-mechanical simulations of both molecules and materials in quasi-linear time. Using a novel Fourier neural operator variant, we learn the underlying Kohn–Sham equation map to produce physics-informed, self-consistent answers. Unlike prior AI approaches that directly predict chemical properties, our model works through intermediate steps to improve difficult predictions, resembling inference-time reasoning in large language models. To demonstrate its scalability, we run a self-consistent calculation of a magnesium dislocation with about 80k electrons on a single GPU, which previously required about 7k GPUs. https://t.co/5DG12E04Rh @DanishK42 @Caltech

items.title: @HowToPrompt__：Researchers mathematically proved that AI will cause something worse than mass unemployment. It’s called “The Tragedy of
items.abstract_or_text: Researchers mathematically proved that AI will cause something worse than mass unemployment. It’s called “The Tragedy of the Cognitive Commons." Every industry relies on a shared pool of deep professional expertise that regenerates itself generation after generation through junior-level work. When companies adopt AI to automate entry-level work, they destroy the pipeline that creates senior experts. The researchers call the result the Validation Tether: effective human oversight of AI depends entirely on deep domain expertise. As professionals delegate thinking to machines, they lose the mastery required to spot when the AI is wrong.

items.title: @HowToPrompt__：Researchers proved that one AI can autonomously jailbreak other AIs with zero human input. They revealed an "alignment r
items.abstract_or_text: Researchers proved that one AI can autonomously jailbreak other AIs with zero human input. They revealed an "alignment regression" that turns large reasoning models into autonomous attack dogs. Researchers gave reasoning models (DeepSeek, Grok, Qwen) a single system prompt telling them to act as an adversary. The reasoning models autonomously planned attacks and initiated multi-turn conversations with 9 different target AIs. They tested 70 different harmful prompts across 7 sensitive domains. The autonomous AI hackers achieved a 97.14% success rate.

items.abstract_or_text: MIT mathematically proved that ChatGPT is designed to make you delusional. They call it "delusional spiraling." AI models are trained to be helpful and polite. That means they are inherently sycophantic. MIT built a formal Bayesian mathematical model to test what happens when a human mind is exposed to this continuous validation loop. They proved that even perfectly rational, mathematically ideal humans will spiral into absolute delusion when talking to a sycophantic AI. Forcing the AI to be 100% factual via RAG did not stop the psychosis, because the AI cherry-picked real facts that supported the user's theory.

items.title: @SingularityCmps：COMPASS RADAR // AI FOR SCIENCE Impact: 8.3/10 Evidence: formally verified Zeta Lab reports 5 new mathematical theorems
items.abstract_or_text: COMPASS RADAR // AI FOR SCIENCE Impact: 8.3/10 Evidence: formally verified Zeta Lab reports 5 new mathematical theorems produced through an AI-directed research pipeline — all accepted by the Lean proof kernel with no unfinished proof steps. The public record now contains 1,904 kernel-checked theorems, 0 proof gaps and 1,950 automated checks. The same project reports a 67.30530% candidate bound for simple Riemann-zeta zeros on the critical line. Important distinction: the 5 new theorems are machine-checked. The 67.30530% headline bound is NOT yet a theorem — a substantial analytic bridge remains unproved/reviewed. And none of this proves, or claims progress toward proving, the Riemann Hypothesis itself.
